**Target:** All creatures in a cone of 3 rows, 1/3/5 squares wide; no exclusions. Each player rolls defense separately. **Player defense:** Fortitude. **Damage type:** cold.

entries.effect: 3 connected empty ground squares within 3: difficult terrain until its next turn.
entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Lay the Rime

*It exhales a low stream of white breath, crusting the ground with brittle ice in front of the pack.*

Make up to 3 connected empty ground squares within 3 squares difficult terrain for everyone until the start of this creature's next turn. Requires a supporting surface. No entry damage, automatic fall or bridge over empty space. Reusing this ability replaces its previous patch.

entries.effect: After an ally closes on an enemy within 3: move 2 to that ally; provokes.
entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Follow the Pack

*One hunter moves and another flows into its wake, tightening the circle without a sound.*

After a visible active ally ends voluntary movement adjacent to a visible enemy within 3 squares of this creature, move up to 2 squares, ending adjacent to that ally. Pay normal terrain costs and provoke normally. The ally must be conscious and not Paralyzed; an uncommanded summon cannot trigger this. No attack or command is granted, and movement granted by a free attack cannot trigger it.

details.flavorMarkdown: *A white wolf speaks through teeth furred with frost and leaves no melted prints even on sunlit snow.*
details.specialtyMarkdown:
### Rime breath

**Target:** All creatures in a cone of 3 rows, 1/3/5 squares wide; no exclusions. Each player rolls defense separately. **Player defense:** Fortitude. **Damage type:** cold.

**Weak defense:** Freezing 2. **Standard defense:** Freezing 1.

**Limit:** Cannot use this attack on consecutive turns, regardless of result.

### Read the Blood Trail

*Its nose lifts, separating the sharp scent of fresh blood from the rest of the air.*

Learn the direction of the nearest Bleeding creature within 6 squares. This does not reveal Hidden, give an exact square or permit a sight-required attack against an unseen target.

### Follow the Pack

*One hunter moves and another flows into its wake, tightening the circle without a sound.*

After a visible active ally ends voluntary movement adjacent to a visible enemy within 3 squares of this creature, move up to 2 squares, ending adjacent to that ally. Pay normal terrain costs and provoke normally. The ally must be conscious and not Paralyzed; an uncommanded summon cannot trigger this. No attack or command is granted, and movement granted by a free attack cannot trigger it.

### Lay the Rime

*It exhales a low stream of white breath, crusting the ground with brittle ice in front of the pack.*

Make up to 3 connected empty ground squares within 3 squares difficult terrain for everyone until the start of this creature's next turn. Requires a supporting surface. No entry damage, automatic fall or bridge over empty space. Reusing this ability replaces its previous patch.
details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Tactics and retreat:** Breathe across a clustered pursuit, then bite or reposition while the breath is unavailable. Use scent to follow the wounded without granting unseen targeting.

**Encounter and conversation:** It offers guidance through a blizzard in exchange for an oath that sounds easier than it is.

**Habitat:** Wild frontier; ancient ruin · **Communication:** None

**Loot:** Recoverable possessions or lair clues chosen for the adventure; body parts grant no automatic special equipment or coin value.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-winter-wolf


**Category:** Beast · **Role:** Cold controller · **CV:** 46

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rime breath | Brawn | 1 Boon | 3 cold damage. | 5 cold damage. Freezing 1. | 8 cold damage. Freezing 2. |

Use the attributes above for defenses named by incoming attacks. Same targeting, limits and costs apply; no opposed second roll.

### CV worksheet

**Reference damage:** 3/5/8

**Reference type:** cold

**Expected targets:** 2

**Utility factor:** 1.8

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.6 → 1.8: Maneuver allowance +0.1, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=4.404, O=11.901. Uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md). Utility is provisional and does not simulate control, positioning or summon choices.

**Ability sources:** [blood scent](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/blood-scent.md), [elemental burn](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/elemental-burn.md), [Follow the Pack](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/follow-the-pack.md), [Lay the Rime](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/lay-the-rime.md).

**Coverage reference:** [Pathfinder family survey](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/family-survey.md); original HOL prose and mechanics.
